title: nuna catalog
description: The catalog servers: SLOs, loads, commits, credential vending, the audit's Kafka acknowledgement and nuna's alerts (backlog 44).

options.content: **Draft (backlog 44, D43).** Written at home against nuna's own meter names and Prometheus' default OTLP translation (dots to underscores, unit and `_total` suffixes); not yet run against live data. The names it assumes, and what to rename if work's Prometheus differs, are in `docs/observability/dashboards-and-alerts.md`.

panels.title: Loads answered 200 within 50 ms
panels.description: The share of loads answered 200 within 50 ms over the time range, summed over the servers. The SLO holds at 99% or more: that is the p99 within 50 ms. From the histogram of nuna.catalog.requests, whose bucket bounds are the SLOs (10, 50 and 300 ms).

targets.expr:
sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="2xx", le=~"50([.]0)?"}[$__range]))
/ sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="2xx"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Loads answered 304 within 10 ms
panels.description: The share of loads answered 304 within 10 ms over the time range, summed over the servers. The SLO holds at 99% or more: that is the p99 within 10 ms. From the histogram of nuna.catalog.requests, whose bucket bounds are the SLOs (10, 50 and 300 ms).

targets.expr:
sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx", le=~"10([.]0)?"}[$__range]))
/ sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Commits answered 200 within 300 ms
panels.description: The share of commits answered 200 within 300 ms over the time range, summed over the servers. The SLO holds at 99% or more: that is the p99 within 300 ms. From the histogram of nuna.catalog.requests, whose bucket bounds are the SLOs (10, 50 and 300 ms).

panels.title: Commits a second, now
panels.description: updateTable and commitTransaction answered 200, a second, summed over the servers (5-minute rate). The build plan's target is at least 500 a second under the M8 SLO run's load; traffic below that in production is demand, not a breach, so no alert reads it.

panels.title: Share within objective
panels.description: Each SLO's share of good answers over 5-minute windows. 99% is the line.

targets.expr:
sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="2xx", le=~"50([.]0)?"}[5m]))
/ sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="2xx"}[5m]))

sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx", le=~"10([.]0)?"}[5m]))
/ sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx"}[5m]))

panels.title: Error-budget burn rate, 1 hour
panels.description: How fast each SLO spends its error budget (1% of answers may miss the objective), over the last hour: 1 spends a 30-day budget in 30 days. The rules page at 14.4 (1 h and 5 min) and at 6 (6 h and 30 min), and warn at 1 (3 days and 6 h).

targets.expr:
(1 - (sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="2xx", le=~"50([.]0)?"}[1h]))
/ sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="2xx"}[1h])))) / 0.01

(1 - (sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx", le=~"10([.]0)?"}[1h]))
/ sum(increase(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx"}[1h])))) / 0.01

panels.title: Commits a second, against the 500 target
panels.description: updateTable and commitTransaction answered 200, a second, summed over the servers. The line is the M8 SLO run's target of at least 500 a second.

panels.title: Loads a second, by outcome
panels.description: loadTable calls, by status class (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx).

panels.title: Share of loads answered 304
panels.description: Loads answered 304 over loads answered 200 or 304 (D14). Before backlog 15's shared credential epoch (D14, amended 2026-11-19) a conditional load answered by another server is a 200, so behind a balancer that is not sticky this share stays low.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome="3xx"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome=~"2xx|3xx"}[5m]))

panels.title: Mean load time, by outcome
panels.description: The mean of nuna.catalog.requests for loadTable. The p99 is in the SLO row: the histogram has only the SLO bounds as buckets, so it says which side of each bound a load fell, not its p99.

targets.expr:
sum by (outcome) (rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_sum{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable"}[5m]))
/ sum by (outcome) (rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable"}[5m]))

panels.title: Failed loads, by error type
panels.description: loadTable answered 4xx or 5xx, by the Iceberg error type the client was answered with.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, error_type) (rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id="loadTable", outcome=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m]))

panels.title: Metadata cache: share of lookups found in memory
panels.description: nuna.catalog.metadata.cache.lookups, hit over all (D14): loads and commits reading a table's current metadata file. Per server and for every catalog: the counter has no catalog label.

panels.title: Commit replies a second, by outcome
panels.description: nuna.catalog.commits: committed, unchanged, replayed, requirement-failed, refused, unknown, failed (catalog-metrics.md).

panels.title: Requirement failures a second, by requirement
panels.description: Commits refused 409 because a requirement did not hold, by the requirement's type: contention with another writer, or a stale client (backlog 25).

panels.title: Refused, unknown and failed commits, by error type
panels.description: refused: any other 4xx (a commit that lost to concurrent commits too many times is CommitFailedException here). unknown: CommitStateUnknownException, the commit may or may not have happened. failed: any other 5xx.

panels.title: Committed a second, by route
panels.description: Commits that changed something, by the route that made them (createTable, updateTable, commitTransaction, registerTable and so on).

panels.title: Mean commit time, answered 200
panels.description: The mean of nuna.catalog.requests for updateTable and commitTransaction answered 200. The SLO row has the share within 300 ms.

targets.expr:
sum by (operation_id) (rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_sum{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id=~"updateTable|commitTransaction", outcome="2xx"}[5m]))
/ sum by (operation_id) (rate(nuna_catalog_requests_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog", operation_id=~"updateTable|commitTransaction", outcome="2xx"}[5m]))

panels.title: Vends a second, by outcome
panels.description: nuna.catalog.credential.vends: issued (minted, one STS AssumeRole), cached, none (the caller declined), failed.

panels.title: Share of vends served from the cache
panels.description: cached over issued and cached.

panels.title: Mean vend time, by outcome
panels.description: The mean of nuna.catalog.credential.vends. An issued vend includes its STS call and the audit of the credential issue.

targets.expr:
sum by (outcome) (rate(nuna_catalog_credential_vends_milliseconds_sum{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog"}[5m]))
/ sum by (outcome) (rate(nuna_catalog_credential_vends_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", catalog=~"$catalog"}[5m]))

panels.title: Failed vends, by error type
panels.description: ServiceUnavailableException when STS or the audit is down; ForbiddenException when the location is outside the storage profile.

panels.title: STS AssumeRole calls a second, by outcome
panels.description: nuna.sts, one per issued vend (spans.md). outcome is issued or error; exception names a failure's type.

panels.title: Mean STS AssumeRole time, by storage profile
panels.description: The mean of nuna.sts for calls that issued credentials.

targets.expr:
sum by (profile) (rate(nuna_sts_milliseconds_sum{job=~"$job", outcome="issued"}[5m]))
/ sum by (profile) (rate(nuna_sts_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", outcome="issued"}[5m]))

panels.title: Mean acknowledgement time, by event
panels.description: nuna.audit.publish: a synchronous audit record (D23), from the send to Kafka's acknowledgement. Mean only: the exported timer has no histogram buckets, so Prometheus cannot give its p99 (backlog 71). The console's health page has the p99.

targets.expr:
sum by (event) (rate(nuna_audit_publish_milliseconds_sum{job=~"$job", outcome="acknowledged"}[5m]))
/ sum by (event) (rate(nuna_audit_publish_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job", outcome="acknowledged"}[5m]))

panels.title: Audit records acknowledged a second, by event
panels.description: nuna.catalog.read, nuna.catalog.credential-issue and the other synchronous events.

panels.title: Failed publishes a second, by exception
panels.description: Each refused the request it audited: audit fails closed (D23).

panels.title: Metadata integrity (pages)
panels.description: A metadata file no longer hashes to what its pointer recorded. The rule NunaMetadataIntegrity pages. Fired in the time range, summed over the servers; the nuna.alerts log line names the table and file.

panels.title: Regulated schema change (warns)
panels.description: A commit changed a regulated table's schema or partition spec. The rule NunaRegulatedSchemaChange warns. Fired in the time range, summed over the servers; the nuna.alerts log line names the table and file.

panels.title: Large metadata (warns)
panels.description: A loaded table's metadata is over the size or snapshot limit (D14), once per file a server loads. The rule NunaLargeMetadata warns. Fired in the time range, summed over the servers; the nuna.alerts log line names the table and file.

panels.title: Alerts fired, by kind
panels.description: Each kind's count, increase over 5 minutes, summed over the servers.
